meta.title: Glasshouse
meta.key: C major: Cmaj9, Am9, Fmaj9, G6/9
meta.words: v3: the music box and tubular bells are now native (struck bars and tubes computed from their physics), and a bell cloud blooms through the breakdown; otherwise as v2. v2, from your notes: no clap and no pad. The gated 16th chord you loved carries the harmony from the intro, closed at first and opening, an LFO on its filter, its accents and voicings moving every eight bars; your glass bass line runs the whole song; a rim and shaker groove off the beats.
